description: This file defines the DateTimeItem class for the Drupal datetime module, implementing a custom field type for date and time storage with configuration options, schema, and sample data generation.

classes.name: DateTimeItem
classes.description: Defines a custom 'datetime' field type for Drupal, handling storage, schema, configuration, and sample data generation for date/time values.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the data properties for the field, including 'value' and 'date'.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides the database schema for storing the date/time value.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring storage settings, specifically the date type.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample date/time value based on the field's configuration.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field value is empty.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the field, ensuring the computed date is recalculated when the value changes.
